archivedReason: Fase pengembangan menggunakan Firebase Firestore agar seluruh perubahan (akun pengguna, RBAC, CMS website, dan data operasional) tetap tersimpan permanen lintas re-publish AI Studio.
systemdUnit:
[Unit]
Description=PocketBase AMS Integrated System
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=amsadmin
WorkingDirectory=/opt/pocketbase-ams
ExecStart=/opt/pocketbase-ams/pocketbase serve --http=127.0.0.1:8091
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
